name: Nordkette
kurzbeschreibung: The Innsbruck Nordkette merges urban sophistication with rugged high mountains: Zaha Hadid's Hungerburgbahn, Seegrube, and Hafelekar at 2,269 meters.
beschreibung:
Overview

The iconic Innsbruck Nordkette forms the world-famous, dramatic limestone backdrop towering directly above the Tyrolean provincial capital. Nowhere else in the Alps do pulsating urban life and sheer alpine wilderness meet so seamlessly: In just twenty minutes, visitors travel from the historic Golden Roof in the city center straight into the high-alpine terrain of the Karwendel mountains at 2,269 meters above sea level. Designed by star architect Zaha Hadid, the futuristic stations of the Hungerburgbahn set architectural benchmarks with flowing forms inspired by natural glacial ice. From the panoramic terraces of the Seegrube and Hafelekar, guests enjoy an awe-inspiring juxtaposition: looking south, the red roofs of Innsbruck and the wide Inn Valley stretch out below, while to the north, the untouched limestone chains of the Karwendel Nature Park command the horizon.

Route & Requirements

Exploring the Nordkette is effortless for visitors of all generations and fitness levels thanks to modern cable cars. From the Hafelekar top station, a paved, barrier-free walking trail reaches the Hafelekarspitze summit cross at 2,334 meters in approximately fifteen minutes. For avid hikers, Hafelekar serves as the starting point for the scenic Goethe Trail, traversing narrow mountain paths and rocky notches towards the picturesque Pfeishütte (walking time approx. 2.5 hours, difficulty T2). Experienced mountaineers with alpine experience tackle the challenging Innsbruck Via Ferrata across seven exposed Karwendel peaks. Solid footwear with non-slip soles, warm clothing layers, and windproof jackets are highly recommended even on warm summer days due to frequent brisk mountain breezes.

Visit & Arrival

Access could hardly be simpler: The Hungerburgbahn departs directly from Congress Innsbruck in the city center, offering seamless connections to local tram and bus lines. Parking is available at discounted rates in the Congress garage. At Hungerburg, passengers transfer smoothly to the Seegrubenbahn cable car and continue onwards to the Hafelekarbahn. The Top of Innsbruck combi-ticket covers the entire round-trip ascent and descent. Cardholders of the Innsbruck Card enjoy fully included access on all sections of the Nordkette lifts.

Tips

Relax on the sunny panorama deck of Restaurant Seegrube with an iced coffee or traditional Tyrolean apple strudel while watching downhill riders conquer the demanding Nordkette Singletrail. On clear evenings, take advantage of the popular Friday evening ascents to admire the shimmering sea of lights across the city below.
preis: Freely accessible; mountain lift ticket Innsbruck-Hafelekar chargeable (Top of Innsbruck ticket)
oeffnungszeiten: Open year-round (note brief maintenance periods in spring and late autumn)
